// Package cardrpg 是角色卡收集养成与三人编队回合制 PvE 的业务消费者，不是框架默认玩法。
package cardrpg

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/configdata"
	"io"
)

var ErrRule = errors.New("card rpg: invalid identity, operation, state, funds or limit")

const LedgerLimit = 64
const ValueLimit int64 = 1000000
const MaxActions = 120
const TurnMillis int64 = 5000

// 所有切片均为定长数组，捕获配置时按值复制，运行中的关卡不读取新一代数值。
type HeroRule struct {
	ID                       int
	HP, Attack, Armor, Speed int64
	Rare                     bool
}
type StageRule struct {
	ID, Waves               int
	HP, Attack              int64
	Energy, Gold, FirstGold int64
}
type Rules struct {
	Version  string
	DrawCost int64
	Pity     int
	Heroes   [6]HeroRule
	Stages   [3]StageRule
}

func DemoRules() Rules {
	r := Rules{Version: "cards-v1", DrawCost: 2, Pity: 5}
	for i := range r.Heroes {
		r.Heroes[i] = HeroRule{ID: i + 1, HP: 80 + int64(i)*5, Attack: 24 + int64(i)*2, Armor: 5, Speed: 20 - int64(i), Rare: i >= 3}
	}
	for i := range r.Stages {
		r.Stages[i] = StageRule{ID: i + 1, Waves: 2, HP: 25 + int64(i)*5, Attack: 4 + int64(i), Energy: 2, Gold: 3, FirstGold: 5}
	}
	return r
}
func (r Rules) Validate() error {
	if len(r.Version) == 0 || len(r.Version) > 64 || r.DrawCost < 1 || r.DrawCost > 100 || r.Pity < 1 || r.Pity > 10 {
		return ErrRule
	}
	for i, h := range r.Heroes {
		if h.ID != i+1 || h.HP < 1 || h.HP > 1000 || h.Attack < 1 || h.Attack > 100 || h.Armor < 0 || h.Armor > 100 || h.Speed < 1 || h.Speed > 100 || h.Rare != (i >= 3) {
			return ErrRule
		}
	}
	for i, s := range r.Stages {
		if s.ID != i+1 || s.Waves < 1 || s.Waves > 3 || s.HP < 1 || s.HP > 1000 || s.Attack < 1 || s.Attack > 100 || s.Energy < 1 || s.Energy > 10 || s.Gold < 0 || s.Gold > 100 || s.FirstGold < 0 || s.FirstGold > 100 {
			return ErrRule
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func (r Rules) Hash() string {
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(r)
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}
func StrictJSON(raw string, out any) error {
	if len(raw) == 0 || len(raw) > 256*1024 {
		return ErrRule
	}
	d := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewBufferString(raw))
	d.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := d.Decode(out); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if d.Decode(new(any)) != io.EOF {
		return ErrRule
	}
	return nil
}
func encode(v any) string {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return string(raw)
}

// 进程启动加载业务表；端点捕获一份 Snapshot，得到 Rules 后再传内部 Sender，公网请求不携带 Rules。
func OpenCatalog(dir string) (*configdata.Store, error) {
	registry := configdata.NewRegistry()
	configdata.MustRegisterObject(registry, configdata.ObjectDef[Rules]{Name: "card_rules", File: "cards.json", Validate: func(_ *configdata.BuildContext, r Rules) error { return r.Validate() }})
	store := configdata.NewStore(registry, dir)
	_, err := store.Load(context.Background())
	return store, err
}
func CaptureRules(snapshot *configdata.Snapshot) (Rules, error) {
	r, ok := configdata.ObjectFrom[Rules](snapshot, "card_rules")
	if !ok {
		return Rules{}, ErrRule
	}
	return r, r.Validate()
}
